resources.string: Verify 10-bit BT.2020 HLG with HEVC or AV1 over RTMP. Screen sharing stays SDR.

Apply stops active sessions and rebuilds the preview with OpenGL, resetting the scene. SDR camera video and images are converted to HLG. HLG uses the Normal effect; recording, snapshots and quality capture are unavailable.
HLG verification requires an RTMP or RTMPS destination. Select SDR for SRT or WHIP/WHEP.
HLG uses OpenGL. Select SDR for both directions before enabling Vulkan.
